system.description:
You manifest a sanguine-colored weapon of your description made from hardened Fire chakra. For the duration, you may spend your Action to make a Sanguine Weapon Attack.

Sanguine Weapon Attack. Make a melee ninjutsu attack dealing 4d6+4 Fire damage on a hit.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher, you can command your Sanguine weapon to move independent of you as it gains a 30-foot fly speed. If you do, it listens to your commands as a bonus action performing an Autonomous Sanguine Weapon Attack.

If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, your Sanguine Weapon Attack can attack twice, instead of once. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, as an Action while you are holding your Sanguine weapon, you can perform a Sanguine Pyronado Attack. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, your Autonomous Sanguine Weapon Attack can attack twice instead of once.

Autonomous Sanguine Weapon Attack. Make a melee ninjutsu attack dealing 2d6+2 Fire damage on a hit.

Sanguine Pyronado Attack. Make a melee ninjutsu attack vs the AC of each creature within 5 feet of you. On a hit, you deal 6d6+6 Fire damage on a hit.
